options.content: MikroTik → SNMPv3 authPriv → Zabbix ROC → Grafana ROC → Andy Ops / MGMT. Native ICMP: 10s, 3 packets per cycle, unavailability after 3 consecutive cycles. Trigger dependencies: L1_PARENT_DOWN → L2_DOMAIN_DOWN → L3_NEIGHBOR_INCOMPLETE → L3_ENDPOINT_UNREACHABLE. Downstream measurements remain visible when alerts are suppressed. UNKNOWN never means PASS. Browser refresh does not trigger SNMP polling.
